QF.id: VI Functions of DP Account Opening_23

question.text: In case of joint demat accounts, joint holders may authorize:

answer.text: Any one of the holders or survivor(s) to operate the account for specified operations such as securities transfers, inter-depository transfers, pledge/hypothecation/margin pledge actions, and freeze/unfreeze of account, ISIN or securities
Only the first-named holder to operate the account
All holders must jointly sign every transaction
Only a nominee to operate the account

explanation.text: The Logic: Joint holders may authorize any one of the holders or survivor(s) to operate the account for specified operations: securities transfers, inter-depository transfers, pledge/hypothecation/margin pledge actions, and freeze/unfreeze of the account, ISIN or securities. All other account-level transactions must continue to be operated jointly by all holders. The Trap: 'All holders must jointly sign' would be the default position absent this authorization; conversely, treating the authorization as covering every transaction would overstate its scope. Note: This is similar to the 'Either or Survivor' mode in bank accounts and provides operational convenience while maintaining joint ownership for non-listed operations.
